title: Proper exchange on all admissible constant-model generators
statement: Fix a prime ell and a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ell. Let Z,Y,Yprime be separated finite-type k-schemes, q:Z→Y proper and v:Yprime→Y a k-morphism. Let Lambda be any admissible commutative condensed ring of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For every ordinary unbounded module-object complex K on Z with bounded constant-model constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude, the component at K of the specified ambient unit/square/counit proper exchange for any chosen Cartesian square of q along v is invertible. No invertibility is asserted for arbitrary unbounded inputs or for nonproper q.

source.place: Proof (2), proper exchange on the localizing generators; proof (3), identity on the open and mate pasting.

proof.text: Apply condensedAmbientExchange_coefficientIso: scalar extension along an isomorphism preserves the constant-model constructible finite-Tor subcategory, its normalized geometric mates are invertible, and the scalar/geometric rectangle transports the actual ambient exchange. This proved helper has no properness hypothesis.

Use the already proved coefficient-presentation helpers finiteBoundaryCoefficientIso, field_realization, unitBall_realization and integerIso in ProperOpenBoundaryZero. They identify small finite continuous coefficients with the sheafified constant ring of their universe lift, Q_ell with a degree-one finite intermediate coefficient field, Z_ell with its unit ball, and the valuation coefficient ring with DerivedNakayama.integerRing of the universe lift. Only these presentation helpers are used from that module, not its boundary-vanishing theorem.

For finite coefficients transfer to finiteProperCoefficientRing of ULift A. The given exponent kills 1 also after lifting, including for the zero ring. Apply clause (2) of finiteProperBaseChange. The finite_ambient_iso helper identifies its exchange with condensedAmbientExchange, since finitePullbackCongr is equality-to-isomorphism transport. Apply the coefficient-isomorphism argument of step 1.

For integral valuation coefficients apply clause (3) of integralProperDirectImageAndFormulas to the bounded constructible input. The finite Tor property is unused in this representative case. Transfer through integerIso and, for Z_ell, the unit-ball presentation of step 2.

For a finite intermediate coefficient field or the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure, the source scheme is Noetherian. The adic constructibility comparison converts the constant-model bounded input to the ordinary bounded constructible subcategory. Equip the chosen Cartesian source A with its k-structure from qprime; the square makes a a k-morphism, and proper base change makes qprime proper, hence A separated of finite type. Bundle the square in Over(Spec k), and apply the already stated rational proper-base-change natural-transformation theorem. The bounded-exchange ambient identification, together with transportedCompositeIso_eq and the definitions of the residue functor wrappers, identifies the component underlying arrow with the exact condensedAmbientExchange in the goal.

Eliminate the six alternatives in IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient. In each alternative compose the supplied coefficient isomorphism with the applicable presentation from step 2 and apply step 1 to the representative result in steps 3-5. The full continuous-map algebraic closure is absent from the current admissibility predicate, so no continuous-algebraic-closure descent branch is required.

lean.statement:
theorem properBaseChange_admissible_generators
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {A Z Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y'.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (q : Z ⟶ Y) [q.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper q]
    (v : Y' ⟶ Y) [v.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    {a : A ⟶ Z} {q' : A ⟶ Y'} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare a q' q v)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Z)))
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Z K ∧ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) :
    IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange Λ sq).app K)
